# Principal Product Manager

Company: Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology
Tracker ID: disney_principal_product_manager_fixture
Location: Glendale, CA
Official source: Company career page
Source type: Direct Employer

## Job Description

The Content Platforms and Operations team is seeking a Principal Product Manager to guide interconnected product and operational capabilities across multiple systems, teams, and business functions.

The role partners with business, operations, engineering, architecture, design, and analytics stakeholders to identify user and business needs, translate complex operational challenges into clear product requirements, and define product strategies, roadmap priorities, and practical operating plans.

Responsibilities include leading discovery through delivery, balancing competing priorities and technical dependencies, making tradeoffs, coordinating launch readiness and adoption, establishing product goals and success measures, and using data and user insights to inform decisions. The role requires strong product judgment, stakeholder alignment, cross-functional leadership, operational expertise, and clear communication in an ambiguous environment.
